name: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd
tagline: India's market-leading synthetic-leather (PU/PVC) manufacturer, almost debt-free with 28% PAT growth in FY26 on a genuine global-OEM export ramp (BMW, Mercedes, Kia-adjacent auto interiors) and a Mexico/Lithuania expansion - a quality compounder, but its Rs 3,196 Cr size and ~10% topline growth argue against a 10x-in-short-order framing despite a four-box score that technically clears the bar
business_overview: Mayur Uniquoters is India's largest manufacturer of artificial leather (PU/PVC vinyl) used in automotive, footwear, and furnishings, with decades of listed history and one of the forum's oldest, longest-running threads (876 posts since inception). Setting up a Mexico manufacturing facility (~Rs 200 Cr capex, 60 lakh metres capacity) to serve US-based auto OEMs post-2026 US-election clarity, plus a Lithuania trading subsidiary for European market access. (Source: external-lead, @StocksAndStoics, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04 - flagged for a 50-70% run in 4-5 months on the auto-demand cycle.)
fundamentals_table: Rs 471.80 - Rs 906.35 (currently ~Rs 745, well off the high)
~32% export / 68% domestic in recent quarters, rising
fundamentals_narrative: A genuine, established quality compounder: market leader in synthetic leather, almost debt-free, consistent dividend payer, with FY26 PAT growth (28.4%) outpacing revenue growth (9.9%) on margin improvement (product mix shift toward high-margin PU/export business). The Mexico and Lithuania expansions are real, board-approved steps to capture US/EU auto-OEM demand (BMW, Mercedes already ramping; the company also called out underinvoicing/duty-manipulation pressure in the domestic PU-import market as a headwind for the broader industry, not specific to Mayur). Promoter has been buying continuously from the open market as of Mar 2026 - a genuine insider-confidence signal. But this is already a Rs 3,196 Cr company growing topline at high-single/low-double-digits - a strong, investable compounder, not the kind of small-base setup a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years framing typically fits.
technical_read: Not pulled - established large/mid-cap with ample public analyst coverage; fundamentals and forum read were sufficient.
sentiment_summary: One of the forum's longest-running threads (876 posts since early listing days). Recent activity (2024-2026) is sparse but substantive: Q1FY25 concall highlights (Mexico capex announcement), a FY24 CARE ratings note (export mix rising, PU capacity utilisation still low at ~20-25%), and the FY26 full-year results filing (May 2026, revenue/PAT both up meaningfully, promoter continuing to buy).
community_signal: ranvir (trusted) posted detailed, balanced Q1FY25 concall highlights - informational, includes both the Mexico-expansion opportunity and the caveat that PU capacity utilisation remains low (~20%). harsh.beria93 (trusted) posted a CARE ratings-note summary (Dec 2024) noting rising export mix and continued low PU utilisation - a recurring, unresolved capacity-utilisation concern. No trusted-user explicit 10x call; sentiment is measured, quality-compounder framing rather than multibagger framing.
bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. Company completed a share buyback in 2022 (unrelated to this cycle). Promoter increasing stake via open-market purchases as of Mar 2026 per a forum post.
bull_case: Market leader, almost debt-free, consistent dividend payer with decades of track record
FY26 PAT +28.4% outpacing revenue +9.9% on margin improvement and export mix shift
Genuine global-OEM export ramp (BMW, Mercedes) with Mexico/Lithuania capacity being added specifically to capture US/EU demand
Promoter buying continuously in the open market (Mar 2026) - insider confidence signal
Trading well below its 52-week high (Rs 745 vs Rs 906) - some room to re-rate on execution
bear_case: Already a Rs 3,196 Cr company with high-single-digit topline growth - not a small-base setup for a 10x-in-short-order thesis
PU-plant capacity utilisation has remained persistently low (~23-25%) for multiple years, confirmed unchanged in Q1 FY27 - the biggest single growth lever isn't yet firing
Mexico capex (~Rs 200 Cr) is now explicitly ON HOLD due to a 25% US tariff - not just an election-timing question as previously framed, pushing out the US-OEM leg by at least several quarters
Domestic market growth has been flat for years per community discussion (a competitor, Jasch Industries, explicitly framed itself as taking domestic PU share from Mayur)
Underinvoicing/duty-manipulation in PU imports is a disclosed industry headwind
verdict_headline: A genuine, well-run quality compounder with a real export-led margin story (four-box score 3.0), but its size and growth rate don't fit a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years framing - thesis_fit neither by judgment call, conviction Medium as a quality holding.
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind weak (real but modest export-OEM ramp; domestic growth flat), tam weak (already a large, established player in a mature synthetic-leather category; Mexico/Lithuania add real but incremental headroom), moat yes (market leader, established relationships with global auto OEMs, decades of track record), valuation yes (~17x P/E on FY26 EPS Rs 44.13 with 28% PAT growth is reasonable) -> score 3.0

Score >=3.0 technically permits the 10x/100x label, but exercising judgment per the decision table's discretion: a Rs 3,196 Cr company growing topline at ~10%/yr would need an implausible re-rating+growth combination to deliver 10x in 2-3 years, and 100x-in-10-years is even further from this company's realistic growth ceiling - the mechanical four-box score doesn't capture this size/growth-rate mismatch, so thesis_fit is set to 'neither' by explicit judgment call rather than the score alone

This is a genuine quality holding worth tracking as a steady compounder, not a screen-fit multibagger candidate under this project's thesis (10x-in-2-3yr or 100x-in-10yr) - conviction Medium reflects business quality, not thesis-fit

No red flag. Source is untrusted external-lead (X triage) - no conviction floor applies. Re-check trigger: PU capacity utilisation finally moving up meaningfully from ~20-25%, or the Mexico facility reaching commercial production

2026-09-12 deep-dive pass 1: Q1 FY27 confirms strong margin execution (25.4% standalone, up from 21%) but also confirms the Mexico capex is formally paused on US tariffs (not just election-timing) - net, the quality-compounder framing and 'neither' thesis-fit both hold unchanged.

four_box.note: Real export-OEM tailwind and reasonable valuation given moat and margin trajectory, but already a large, mature-category player - thesis_fit set to 'neither' by judgment despite the score, given size/growth-rate mismatch with a 10x/100x framing
